column1: # Cebuano closed-class words the Wiktionary extract gets wrong or lacks (tunatale-u8nz.21).
# Hand-curated. scripts/build_cebuano_lemma_table.py makes each row THE default reading of its surface;
# Wiktionary's own readings stay, as non-defaults.
# Why: kaikki's "article" POS is not in the shared POS map, and the extract has no entry at all for
# mga, ka, si, ni, aron, usab, o — among the 20 commonest tokens in Cebuano news.
# ⚠️ wala and kini are VOCAB cards in both learners' decks (measured 2026-09-27; ka was too, until 2026-09-28). A function-word
# UPOS (ADP DET CCONJ SCONJ PART) would make a lesson treat them as clozes and stop matching those
# cards, so they get content UPOS here. Every function-word row below is either already a cloze in the
# decks or not a card at all.
# Lemmas: a surface keeps itself unless it is a contraction or case form of another word listed here.
